summary: Package E1 of the easter-egg plan: hidden achievements the fights earn. Earned in code (Achievements.for_fight and for_story_fight) from the fight tally, the burst barrels and the run's counts.

achievements.name: A Little Push
achievements.text: On a hero's turn, send a foe over the edge of a map's open drop.

achievements.name: Spark and Barrel
achievements.text: Catch two foes or more in the burst of one barrel of lamp oil.

achievements.name: Knocked, Not Killed
achievements.text: Knock out 10 foes in one playthrough instead of killing them.
